scope: Static original-source threshold extraction; no game execution, state edits or save generation
comparison: first nonzero threshold>=roll for prefix; first threshold>=roll for suffix

boundary_semantics.suffix_zero: ordinary threshold; not a terminator; actual first threshold in every row is positive
boundary_semantics.threshold100: inclusive comparison, but accepted random rolls stop at99
boundary_semantics.suffix_padding: four zero bytes after56 logical IDs; never selected by actual rows
boundary_semantics.suffix_table_end: next routine96:$6C61; no extra level band or suffix names

probability_limit: roll_counts count the100 accepted roll values; they are not an exhaustive distribution over correlated PRNG seed states

terrain.selector: RNG low2bits selects one of4 cells; retry zero, subtract1 for class
